evidence.result: 39 and 50 registered public tools inventoried. 60 task-owned tools mapped; remaining tools assigned to build, plan, source-control.

evidence.command: gcode outline/symbol-at on task registries; AST function inventory
evidence.result: Mapped exact implementation symbols. Inspected creation criteria checks, claim conflict/one-claim checks, close/background review, artifact authority, stage submission, task backup, and live-session label authorization.

evidence.command: uv run gobby tasks --help; uv run gobby tasks validate --help; gcode outline/grep on src/gobby/cli/tasks
evidence.result: Verified command inventory and required leaf validation summary. Mutating-subcommand --help calls were hook-blocked; options checked from Click declarations and isolated CliRunner tests, not live mutations.
Verified task CRUD, lifecycle, comment, dependency, stage, registry and defaults route ownership. Added omitted registry/default mutation routes; labeled HTTP as operator/client surface.

evidence.command: gcode symbol-at src/gobby/tasks/expansion/_contract.py:255; inspect bundled developer/reviewer skill/rule definitions
evidence.result: One per-entry task; tdd flag adds required skill/label. Runtime test-write gate is distinct from transcript-backed red/green evidence.

evidence.command: gobby-workflows:get_rule for require-task-close, require-epic-tree-close, enforce-tdd-block, enforce-tdd-track-tests
evidence.result: All four source=installed, enabled=true, project_id=null on audit date.

evidence.command: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://gobby_test:gobby_test@127.0.0.1:60892/gobby_test GOBBY_TEST_PROTECT=1 uv run pytest tests/mcp_proxy/tools/tasks/test_create_task.py tests/mcp_proxy/tools/tasks/test_mcp_close_checklist.py tests/mcp_proxy/tools/test_task_dependencies.py tests/mcp_proxy/tools/test_tasks_ops_artifacts.py tests/mcp_proxy/tools/test_live_session_label.py tests/tasks/test_task_backup.py tests/workflows/test_rule_engine_task_helper_wiring.py tests/cli/test_tasks_cli.py tests/servers/routes/test_tasks_routes.py tests/tasks/test_tdd_criteria_generation.py -q
evidence.result: Final focused rerun: 372 passed. Initial run exposed two stale CLI owner-session fixtures, repaired with complete Session-derived rows and canonical project-qualified ref assertions.
evidence.limitation: Representative behavior evidence, not a claim that every public tool was independently invoked.

evidence.command: uv run python: catalog load, AST symbol resolution, Markdown local link/anchor validation (script recorded in session transcript)
evidence.result: 1 capability, 68 operation records, 13 Markdown files validated; no missing paths, symbols, or anchors.

evidence.command: uv run python: recursively inspect visible Click commands, unwrapped callback source identities and parameter declarations without invoking callbacks
evidence.result: Mapped previously omitted public command identities, including operator task/plan equivalents and PostgreSQL administration. All mappings point to existing operation topics; CLI callbacks were not invoked against live state.

discrepancies.finding: Docs creation example omitted validation_criteria and implied only code required criteria.
discrepancies.resolution: Corrected all-category non-epic requirement and example.

discrepancies.finding: Close examples advised retrying until closed and described all epics as gate-free.
discrepancies.evidence: close_task schema and current background-close behavior; tasks skill completion contract
discrepancies.resolution: Added durable validator wait and post-close memory sequence; preserved work gates for claimed/committed parents.

discrepancies.finding: Shell examples used unquoted #N references and CLI option tables omitted validation criteria.
discrepancies.evidence: Shell token syntax and Click declarations in cli/tasks/crud.py; validate --help
discrepancies.resolution: Quoted concrete refs and corrected criteria/summary options.

discrepancies.finding: Live-session source skill promised turn-end label exemptions removed by current rules.
discrepancies.evidence: commit 6ba3f3c6c69ec1484c4cde870d790f39327fd06f; installed rules; test_rule_engine_task_helper_wiring tests reject both label bypasses
discrepancies.resolution: Preserved the newer durable-stop-wait contract. New live-work reference and guide explicitly deny label bypass. No enforcement was weakened.

discrepancies.finding: Review source reference implied stage submission uses the complete interactive close checklist.
discrepancies.evidence: _stage_review.submit_for_review performs scope/commit linking and stage transition, distinct from close orchestration
discrepancies.resolution: Explained distinct review policies and lifecycle checks, retaining implementer/reviewer obligations.

discrepancies.finding: Two CLI tests supplied incomplete session rows and expected unqualified owner refs.
discrepancies.resolution: Use complete Session-derived fixture rows; assert gobby#N and full-UUID orphan fallback.

discrepancies.finding: HTTP guide omitted stage registry/default mutation routes.
discrepancies.resolution: Added registered PUT/POST/DELETE routes and explicit operator/client boundary.

cutover_dependencies: P4 migrates live-session label authorization and workflow requirements to exact references; P5 removes folded skill entrypoints. No compatibility wrappers.
